steps.title: Welcome to LAD Board
steps.subtitle: Your Local Autonomous Domain
steps.description: LAD Board is a local-first, agent-driven cognitive workspace designed to turn messy life items into structured, ambient knowledge cards. 100% private, offline-capable, and fully in your control.
highlights: Local-First & Offline Capable: All data stays in your browser & devices
Granular Cloud Sync: Connect Google Drive with non-destructive conflict solving
Zero-Waste Navigation: Cards flow seamlessly without wasted white space

steps.title: Smart Natural Language Capture
steps.subtitle: Type naturally, let LAD structure it
steps.description: Quickly add thoughts, appointments, balances, and checklists by typing naturally in the capture bar. LAD automatically infers domains, due dates, and custom card types.
highlights: Press Enter to capture in seconds
NLP slots parse bank names, medical specialties, and dates automatically
Configurable title wildcards format cards instantly

steps.title: Chronological Stacks & Views
steps.subtitle: Zero wasted space, sorted recent to old
steps.description: Cards are organized into category stacks flowing chronologically from newest to oldest. Switch between Category Stacks and Masonry Flow at any time with no vertical gaps.
highlights: Recent to Old: Newest cards always appear at the top of each stack
Dual View Mode: Toggle between Category Stacks and fluid Masonry Flow
Multilingual Search: Fast, diacritic-insensitive search across all fields

steps.title: Spaces & Collaboration
steps.subtitle: Strict identity verification & granular sharing
steps.description: Organize your life into dedicated spaces (Personal, Family, Projects). Invite collaborators with verified email authentication and Google Drive folder permissions.
highlights: Isolate Personal vs Work contexts cleanly
Invite collaborators with verified email matching
Interactive Conflict Solver protects everyone's concurrent changes

steps.title: Local-First Sync Engine
steps.subtitle: Always online or offline, never lose a change
steps.description: LAD queues all mutations locally in IndexedDB. When online, changes sync with peer-to-peer and cloud storage with Lamport clock causal ordering.
highlights: Automatic offline queue with instant replay
Granular delta-file updates (only edited cards sync)
Zero data overwrites with side-by-side Conflict Solver
